tei:div.tei:p: "` "!# bla ma yid bzhin nor bu'i gsol 'debs dbang bzhi myur 'bebs bzhugs so:༙ gsol 'debs le'u bzhi pa phyi nang gsang gsum zab bo:༙ :༙

bla ma yid bzhin nor bu la phyag 'tshal lo:༙ bla ma yid bzhin nor bu las:༙ dkyil 'khor mu tig phreng skor lugs kyi gsol 'debs dbang bzhi myur 'bebs bya ba ni:༙ jo mo mtsho rgyal gus pas nyon:༙ dag snang tshom bur byung bzhin du:༙ dmigs pas gsol ba 'debs par gyis:༙ byin rlabs thog bab nyid du 'byung:༙ e ma ho:༙ gsang sngags bstan pa rmad byung shākya'i zhing:༙ gsang sngags bdag po o rgyan chos kyi rje:༙ 'khor du grub thob rig 'dzin rgya mtshos bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che:༙ gu ru thugs rje can gyis byin gyis rlobs:༙ gsol 'debs bu la dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs skur:༙ ces tshig 'og ma gsum po 'gres su bya/ 'og min chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing khams su:༙ ston pa pad 'byung rdo rje 'chang chen la:༙ bde gshegs rigs kyi tshom bu 'bum phrag bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che:༙ gu ru thugs rje can gyis byin gyis rlobs:༙ gsol 'debs bu la dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs skur:༙ lhun grub 'od lnga dag pa'i zhing mchog na:༙ padma longs sku sangs rgyas rigs lnga la:༙ rigs lnga zhi khro tshom bu 'bum phrag bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= 'ja' 'od me dpung 'bar ba'i zhing khams su:༙ padma che mchog dpal chen he ru ka:༙ khro bo khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'bum phrag bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rab brtan bde ba chen po'i zhing khams su:༙ ston pa o rgyan mgon po tshe dpag med:༙ 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin 'bum phrag bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= pho brang ri bo ta la'i zhing mchog tu:༙ padma thugs rje chen po 'gro 'dul la:༙ thugs rje rigs 'dus tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= 'khor lo rtse lnga 'bar ba'i zhing khams su:༙

padma 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la:༙ sku yi rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma dbang chen rta mchog la:༙ gsung gi rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= gnas mchog lcang lo 'bar ba'i zhing khams su:༙ padma gsang sngags mdzod 'dzin phyag rdor la:༙ thugs kyi rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= bai ḍūrya yi zhing khams dri med du:༙ padma sangs rgyas sman bla chen po la:༙ drang srong sman gyi lha tshogs 'bum phrag bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= bskal bzang sangs rgyas gaṅga'i zhing khams su:༙ padma sangs rgyas phrin las gcig bsdus la:༙ bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong dang rtsa gnyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= gnas mchog padma 'od kyi zhing khams su:༙ padma chos rgyal drag por smra ba la:༙ sha za srin po'i rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= o rgyan mkha' spyod rig 'dzin zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma gar gyi dbang phyug la:༙ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= dbang drag rta mchog rol pa'i zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan dregs 'dul padma dbang drag la:༙ rta mchog rol pa gsang sngags lha yis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= 'thug po bkod pa'i zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan chen po bhuddha thod phreng rtsal:༙ sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= mngon par dga' ba'i zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙

o rgyan chen po rdo rje thod phreng rtsal:༙ rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan chen po ratna thod phreng rtsal:༙ rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= bde ba can gyi zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan chen po padma thod phreng rtsal:༙ padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan chen po karma thod phreng rtsal:༙ karma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= shar phyogs gtum drag 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas:༙ o rgyan rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas la:༙ mi phyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= shar lho bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du:༙ gu ru o rgyan padma saṃ bha la:༙ mi 'da' gnyan gyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= lho phyogs sku la rdzogs pa'i dur khrod nas:༙ gu ru padma blo ldan mchog sred la:༙ gzi brjid rin chen mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= lho nub bde chen brdal ba'i dur khrod du:༙ o rgyan chen po padma rgyal po la:༙ sna tshogs dbang gi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= nub phyogs padma brtsegs pa'i dur khrod nas:༙ gu ru padma nyi ma 'od zer la:༙ dri med padma mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= nub byang lhun grub brtsegs pa'i dur khrod nas:༙

gu ru padma shākya seṅge la:༙ kun tu rgyu ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= byang phyogs kī la sgrog pa'i dur khrod du:༙ gu ru padma seṅge sgra sgrog la:༙ mi thub karma mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= byang shar laṅka brtsegs pa'i dur khrod na:༙ gu ru padma rdo rje gro lod la:༙ rig 'dzin 'jig rten mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= dri ma med pa'i zhing mchog dam pa na:༙ gu ru padma skyed bzang chen po la:༙ dri med rigs kyi rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= yon tan 'byung gnas zhing mchog dam pa na:༙ gu ru padma 'od bkod chen po la:༙ yon tan rigs kyi tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rgyan rnams bkod pa'i zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan gu ru padma gar dbang la:༙ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag du mas bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= bag tsha med pa'i zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma don yod rdo rje la:༙ don grub rigs kyi lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rnam par mdzes ldan dam pa'i zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma 'khrul zhig seṅge la:༙ rtog bral rnal 'byor rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rab tu snang bar byed pa'i zhing mchog tu:༙ o rgyan padma 'dzum bzhad rtsal 'chang la:༙ pha rgyud gsal snang tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rab tu snang byed zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma thugs rje 'gro 'dul la:༙

thugs rje rigs 'dus tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= gdung ba rab sel zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma 'jig rten dbang phyug la:༙ gsung gi dbang phyug tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rnam par yongs su snang ba'i zhing mchog tu:༙ o rgyan padma 'khor ba dong sprugs la:༙ thugs rje can gyi tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rin chen bkod pa'i zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma rab byung thub dbang la:༙ nyan thos cha 'dzin tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rnam par bkram pa'i zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma shugs can 'khor lo la:༙ 'jigs brgyad skyob pa'i tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rin chen gser 'od dam pa'i zhing mchog tu:༙ o rgyan padma dpal 'bar zhes bya la:༙ gser gyi yan lag tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= bai ḍūrya yi zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma kun skyong chen po la:༙ sman bla rigs kyi tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= yid la mngon dga'i zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma me long rgyal po la:༙ stong nyid ye shes tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= dkyil 'khor me long brgyan pa'i zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma cod pan thod phreng rtsal:༙ mnyam nyid grub pa'i tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= zla ba rab brgyan zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma yid snang cod pan la:༙

so sor rtog pa'i tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= nyi zla 'od gsal brgyan pa'i zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma ind+ra nī la la:༙ bya grub ye shes tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= spos kyi dri ldan zhing khams dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma rnam dag ye shes la:༙ chos dbyings ye shes tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rnam par spro byed zhing khams dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma me long rgyal po la:༙ me tog rigs kyi tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rin chen 'phro byed zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma rgyal po ki ling la:༙ thugs kyi rigs kyi tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= 'od zer 'byung gnas zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma 'gro ba kun skyong la:༙ gsung gi rigs kyi tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= dga' ba rnam dag zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma g.yul ngo rnam rgyal la:༙ sku yi rigs kyi tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= gtsug tor rnam bkod zhing mchog dam pa ru= o rgyan padma srid gsum mgon po la:༙ yon tan rigs kyi tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= nges pa can gyi zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma ko sha'i rgyal po la:༙ phrin las rigs kyi tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= nges par 'phags pa'i zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma bshes gnyen lam ston la:༙ rbod gtong rigs kyi tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙

gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= bde bar spyod par byed pa'i zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma gcod 'joms chen po la:༙ mchod bstod rigs kyi tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= padma bkram byed rgyas pa'i zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma rang byung 'dod dgu la:༙ drag sngags rigs kyi tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= yongs su rab grags zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma 'dren mchog ded dpon la:༙ sku gsum rigs 'dus tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rnam par 'phrul byed zhing khams dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma bka' rtags rgyal po la:༙ pha rgyud lha tshogs tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rnam par sbyangs pa'i zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma klong yangs rnam dag la:༙ ma rgyud lha tshogs tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= padma sman mchog rnam rgyal zhing mchog tu:༙ o rgyan padma rab dga' spyod yul la:༙ sman gyi lha tshogs tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= gser gyi snang 'od zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma rin chen sna tshogs la:༙ 'dod 'byung nor lha'i lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= bkod pa 'od zer zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma drag po phur pa la:༙ sgrol byed lha tshogs tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rin chen dam pa gser 'byung zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma lhun grub dbang chen la:༙ dbang gi lha tshogs tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor:༙

gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= dpal gyi 'byung gnas zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma skye med mtha' bral la:༙ phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= snang byed dam pa'i zhing khams 'od snang du:༙ o rgyan padma 'jigs med bde sbyin la:༙ tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= mya ngan med pa'i zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma mthong grol legs pa la:༙ sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= dga' ba mdangs can zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma skyes mchog nam mkha' la:༙ rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= gzi brjid 'byung ba'i zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma padma saṃ bha la:༙ lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= 'dus byas sangs rgyas zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma rin chen phreng spras la:༙ bya rgyud rigs kyi lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= yang dag sbyong byed zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma bkram rgyan dbyer med la:༙ sbyong rgyud rigs kyi lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= sbyong byed tha dad snang ba'i zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma mi nub rgyal mtshan la:༙ gnyis med rigs kyi lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= dpung rgyan rgyal mtshan zhes bya'i zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma mun sel snang byed la:༙ bla med rnal 'byor lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor:༙

gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= padma rgyan mdzes zhing khams dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma mi yi rgyal po la:༙ ma hā yo ga'i lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rab tu mdzes par snang ba'i zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma 'khor ba'i g.yul zlog la:༙ a nu yo ga'i lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= tsandan bkod pa'i zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma rnam par rol pa la:༙ a ti rigs kyi lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= seṅge 'byung gnas zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma tha mi dad pa la:༙ yang ti ti la'i lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= 'og phyogs rgya mtsho chen po'i zhing mchog tu:༙ o rgyan padma klu rgyal dga' bo la:༙ klu yi rigs kyi rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= mi yul o rgyan rgya gar bod yul du:༙ o rgyan padma mi yi slob dpon la:༙ mi yi rig 'dzin byang sems 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= steng phyogs rnam par rgyal ba'i zhing mchog dam pa ru:༙ o rgyan padma lha yi rig 'dzin la:༙ lha yi rig 'dzin drang srong 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= dmyal ba na ra ka yi zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma rnam par gnon pa la:༙ sdug bsngal sel byed rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= yi dwags pre ta ka yi zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma rnam par snang byed la:༙ dbul ba sel ba'i rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje=

gsol 'debs bu la= byol song tirya ka yi zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma seṅge sgra sgrog la:༙ mun sel shes rab rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= 'dzam gling dbus 'gyur mi yi zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma mi yi rig 'dzin la:༙ rig 'dzin grub thob 'bum phrag du mas bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= dga' ldan phun tshogs lha yi zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma srid thub 'dzin pa la:༙ lha yi rig 'dzin sangs rgyas 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= lha min he sa ka yi zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma rnam par rgyal ba la:༙ lha min sde brgyad rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= ma 'ongs bskal pa byams chen zhing khams su:༙ o rgyan padma rgyal sras 'gro 'dul la:༙ ma 'ongs byang sems rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= gter 'byung mi zad zhing mchog dam pa na:༙ gu ru padma zil gnon rtsal zhes la:༙ smon lam rnam dag rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= 'dod 'byung bsod nams rang bzhin zhing khams na:༙ gu ru padma nor gyi dbang phyug la:༙ nor 'byung gnod sbyin rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i zhing khams na:༙ gu ru padma dbang mdzad rdo rje la:༙ dbang sdud rig byed rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= drag pos dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i zhing khams na:༙ gu ru padma 'jigs byed drag po rtsal:༙ sgrol byed dregs pa'i rig 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so=

gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= lha srin sde brgyad bsgral ba'i zhing khams na:༙ gu ru padma dmar nag me phreng rtsal:༙ dregs pa sde brgyad rigs kyi rig 'dzin 'bum:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= dkyil 'khor shar phyogs dur khrod zhing khams su:༙ rdo rje rigs la dbang ba'i sgo srung che:༙ zhi byed rdo rje ging chen yab yum la:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= dkyil 'khor lho phyogs dur khrod zhing khams su:༙ rin chen rigs la dbang ba'i sgo srung che:༙ rgyas mdzad rin chen ging chen yab yum la:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= dkyil 'khor nub phyogs dur khrod zhing khams su:༙ padma'i rigs la dbang ba'i sgo srung che:༙ dbang mdzad padma ging chen yab yum la:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= dkyil 'khor byang phyogs dur khrod zhing khams su:༙ karma rigs la dbang ba'i sgo srung che:༙ sgrol byed karma ging chen yab yum la:༙ gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che:༙ gu ru thugs rje can gyis byin gyis rlobs:༙ gsol 'debs bu la dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs skur:༙

ces de ltar rgyud chad med par gsol ba thob:༙ gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs 'byung:༙ tshe 'dir padma bdag gi thugs rjes bzung:༙ sgo gsum smin cing grol te sangs rgyas thob:༙ phyi ma bar dor tshom bu'i lha tshogs mjal:༙ lhun grub 'od gsal tshom bu'i klong du thim:༙ tha ma srid pa bar dor padma bdag:༙ gsol 'debs bu de bsu bar ma gcig pos:༙ bu nyid rab khar 'phrad ltar mkha' spyod du:༙ nges par 'dren no padma'i tha tshig yin:༙ zhes gsungs de nas jo mo yis:༙ phyi ltar gsol 'debs de ltar na:༙ nang ltar gsol ba ji ltar btab:༙ ces zhus gu rus gsungs pa la:༙ e ma ho:༙ nyon dang jo mo skal pa can:༙ nang gi gsol ba btab yul ni:༙ yi dam dkyil 'khor lha yin te:༙ lha tshogs phyi rol yul du med:༙ rang lus rgyal ba'i pho brang la:༙ rtsa gsum lha yi dkyil 'khor yod:༙ snying khar gsang chen zhi ba'i lha:༙ dpral bar che mchog khro bo la:༙ mgrin par thugs rje chen po la:༙ lte bar rta mchog rol pa la:༙ gsang bar mkha' 'gro ma mo'i tshogs:༙ ba spu rdo rje gsang sngags lha:༙ rdo rje theg pa'i lha kun yod:༙ spyi bor bka' brgyud bla mar bcas:༙ yan lag chos srung dpa' bo ging:༙ de phyir gsol ba 'di bzhin thob:༙ hūm̐:༙ chos dbyings dag pa mkha' spyod zhing:༙ gtsug tor nam mkha'i pho brang du:༙ bka' brgyud rig 'dzin ston pa bcu:༙ dgongs brda snyan brgyud bcas pa la:༙ mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs:༙ gsol 'debs bu la dbang skur cig:༙ sa la gnas dang tshe la dbang:༙ phyag rgya chen po lhun gyis grub:༙ rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin dang:༙ o rgyan rig 'dzin padma 'byung:༙ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma la:༙ mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs:༙ gsol 'debs bu la dbang skur cig:༙ 'og min stug po bkod pa'i gnas:༙ tsitta 'od lnga'i pho brang na:༙ bcom ldan rigs lnga sems dpa' brgyad:༙ nye 'khor yab yum bcu bcus bskor:༙

sgo ba yab yum thub chen drug:༙ gsang chen dam pa rigs brgya la:༙ mos gus gdung bas= gsol 'debs bu la= dur khrod 'jigs pa'i pho brang che:༙ dung khang me ri 'bar ba na:༙ khrag 'thung khro chen rigs lnga dang:༙ bka' brgyad ma mo phra men tshogs:༙ dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad bcas:༙ mos gus gdung bas= gsol 'debs bu la= thugs rje po ta la yi zhing:༙ longs spyod mgrin pa'i pho brang na:༙ thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs:༙ sa bcu'i sems dpa' sems ma dang:༙ thugs rjes sprul pa'i lha tshogs la:༙ mos gus gdung bas= gsol 'debs bu la= me rlung rta mchog rol pa'i zhing:༙ lte ba sprul pa'i pho brang na:༙ yi dam rta mgrin yab yum sras:༙ sgrol yum phra men sku gsung thugs:༙ sprul pa yang sprul pho nyar bcas:༙ grangs med lhag pa'i lha tshogs la:༙ mos gus gdung bas= gsol 'debs bu la= dur khrod gsang chen rol pa'i zhing:༙ gsang gnas bde chen pho brang na:༙ bdud 'dul siṃ ha mu kha le:༙ phyag bzhi ma mo dam can tshogs:༙ zhing skyong gza' dang rdo rje legs:༙ srog len khyung zhon drag po bzhi:༙ bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho la:༙ mos gus gdung bas= gsol 'debs bu la= dbyings dang ye shes dag pa'i zhing khams su:༙ rtsa rlung thig le 'bar ba'i dur khrod na:༙ rta phag yab yum gsang ba ye shes la:༙ dkar dmar mthing dang sgrol ma lha mo'i tshogs:༙ mkha' 'gro rigs lnga ye shes las las grub:༙ mos gus gdung bas= gsol 'debs bu la= srid pa gsum gyi dur khrod gnyan po'i gnas:༙ bye ba phrag brgya phung po'i dur khrod na:༙ zhing skyong mkha' 'gro ging dang laṅka'i tshogs:༙ dpal mgon bdun cu pho nya bka' sdod sogs:༙ legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam can rgya mtsho la:༙ mos gus gdung bas= gsol 'debs bu la= gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che:༙ byin gyis rlobs shig yi dam gu ru rje:༙ dngos grub stsol dang mkha' 'gro padma 'byung:༙

bar chad sol cig chos skyong bla ma rje:༙ phrin las sgrubs shig dam can thod phreng rtsal:༙ sgrub mchog bu la dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs skur:༙ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug sgrub pa mthar phyin nas:༙ phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub byin gyis rlobs:༙ gu ru'i sku gsung thugs yon mdzad mnyam nas/ bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs:༙ srid gsum 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya ru:༙ gang 'dul sprul pa 'gyed par byin gyis rlobs:༙ gu ru khyed kyis dngos grub brnyes pa de:༙ sgrub mchog bu yis brnyes par byin gyis rlobs:༙ gu ru khyed kyis sprul pa 'gyed pa ltar:༙ sgrub mchog bu yis 'gyed par byin gyis rlobs:༙ tshe rabs skye ba dag par rgyud bskul nas:༙ 'gro don 'khor ba dong sprugs nus par shog:༙ ces pa'i gsol ba btab pa dang:༙ gus pas skyo shas mos gus bskyed:༙ nges 'byung dad pa skyes pa dang:༙ gnyis med yid kyis mnyam par zhog:༙ gang ltar 'dod pa de yis 'grub:༙ ces gsungs pas mtsho rgyal gyis zhus pa:༙ nang ltar gsol 'debs de ltar na:༙ gsang ba'i gsol 'debs ji ltar lags:༙ ma hā gu rus gsung du gsol:༙ e ma ho:༙ nyon cig snod ldan skal ldan mo:༙ gsang ltar gsol ba 'di ltar thob:༙ ces gsungs gu ru 'od dpag med du gyur:༙ spyi bor badzra gu ru yab yum la:༙ rdo rje mkha' 'gro sum brgya drug cu:༙ mgrin par padma gu ru yab yum la:༙ padma mkha' 'gro bcu drug:༙ thugs kar buddha gu ru yab yum la:༙ buddha ḍā ki brgyad:༙ lte bar ratna gu ru yab yum la:༙ ratna ḍā ki drug cu:༙ gsang gnas karma gu ru yab yum la:༙ karma ḍā ki nyi shu rtsa bzhis bskor ba dang:༙ gzhan yang ba spu'i khung bu thams cad dpa' bo dpa' mo'i lha tshogs til gyi gong bu kha phyes pa ltar bstan nas bka' bstsal pa:༙ e ma ho:༙ sku gsum dag pa'i zhing khams su:༙ sangs rgyas rigs 'dus o rgyan padma la:༙

sku gsum yi dam ḍā ki'i tshogs kyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i tshogs:༙ gu ru thugs rje can gyis byin gyis rlobs:༙ gsol 'debs bu la dbang bzhi lhun grub skur:༙ rtse mo rnam bkod spyi bo'i 'khor lo ru:༙ lha mchog badzra gu ru yab yum la:༙ rdo rje ḍā ki sum brgya drug cus bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= mgrin pa ro 'dus ngag gi 'khor lo ru:༙ lha mchog padma gu ru yab yum la:༙ padma rigs kyi ḍā ki bcu drug bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= snying kha dran bkod chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus:༙ lha mchog buddha gu ru yab yum la:༙ buddha rigs kyi ḍā ki brgyad kyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= lte ba sprul pa skyed byed dkyil 'khor dbus:༙ lha mchog ratna gu ru yab yum la:༙ rin chen rigs kyi ḍā ki drug cus bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= gsang gnas bde ba myong byed tsakra'i dbus:༙ lha mchog karma gu ru yab yum la:༙ karma rigs kyi ḍā ki rtsa bzhis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rtsa chen rtsa phran stong phrag bdun cu ru:༙ rigs 'dus gu ru chen po gtso dgu la:༙ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bdun cus bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= rnam shes tshogs brgyad 'byung lnga khams lnga'i zhing:༙ sprul pa'i sku mchog gu ru mtshan brgyad la:༙ rigs lnga yab yum mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje= gsol 'debs bu la= dbang po tshogs drug rten 'brel bcu gnyis la:༙ o rgyan gu ru zhi khro sna tshogs gzugs:༙ 'dod yon tshogs drug lha dang lha mos bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so= gu ru thugs rje=

gsol 'debs bu la= ba spu bye ba nyi khri chig stong la:༙ o rgyan yang sprul bye ba nyi khri'i tshogs:༙ ging dang chos skyong dam can rgya mtshos bskor:༙ gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i tshogs:༙ gu ru thugs rje can gyis byin gyis rlobs:༙ gsol 'debs bu la dbang bzhi lhun grub skur:༙ thugs yid gcig tu bsres la dbang 'di zhus:༙ ho:༙ sprul pa'i sku mchog o rgyan rin po che:༙ sgrub mchog bu dang mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gyi:༙ spyi bo bde chen lus kyi 'khor lo'i dbus:༙ brtan par bzhugs la dga' ba'i bum dbang skur:༙ gang 'dul sprul pa 'gyed par byin gyis rlobs:༙ longs spyod rdzogs sku o rgyan rin po che:༙ sgrub mchog bu dang mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gyi:༙ mgrin pa ro 'dus ngag gi 'khor lo'i dbus:༙ brtan par bzhugs la mchog dga'i gsang dbang skur:༙ theg chen chos kyis 'gro 'dul byin gyis rlobs:༙ chos sku kun bzang o rgyan rin po che:༙ sgrub mchog bu dang mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gyi:༙ snying kha dran bkod chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus:༙ brtan par bzhugs la dga' bral sher dbang skur:༙ mkhyen gsum dbyer med 'gro 'dul byin gyis rlobs:༙ ngo bo nyid sku o rgyan rin po che:༙ sgrub mchog bu dang mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gyi:༙ lte ba sprul pa skyed byed 'khor lo'i dbus:༙ brtan par bzhugs la lhan dga'i don dbang skur:༙ snang srid 'khor 'das dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs:༙ mngon par byang chub o rgyan rin po che:༙ sgrub mchog bu dang mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gyi:༙ gsang gnas bde ba myong byed tsakra'i dbus:༙ brtan par bzhugs la phrin las bzhi dbang skur:༙ bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro 'dul byin gyis rlobs:༙ rdo rje sku mchog o rgyan rin po che:༙ sgrub mchog bu dang mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gyi:༙ tsitta rin chen sems kyi dkyil 'khor du:༙
